entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Stamp Duties Act, 1972 (s. 35: Minister amends the Schedule) and Schedule
entries.why: the Schedule's conveyance / lease-transfer item is not held: only the Stamp Duties (Amendment of Schedule) Regulations, 2014 (L.N. 17 of 2014, R4/fetch/p14/ls_stamp_2014.pdf: item 19 (4) marketable securities) is held; LesothoLII search returns no copy of the 1972 Act
entries.tried: LesothoLII search API (seventeenth pass); LRA site (earlier passes)

entries.name: Employer social security contributions
entries.statute: US SSA, Social Security Programs Throughout the World (SSPTW), Africa 2019 — Lesotho (Wayback copy, R4/fetch/ssptw11/lesotho.txt)
entries.why: LS old-age pension is universal and tax-financed ('Employer: None. Government: The total cost'); sickness/maternity cash benefits are employer liability; work injury is an employer-liability system through a private carrier. No public-fund employer contribution. Secondary source (2019).
